title: job.decision
description: A choice the engine made about a file, as a code with params, never a sentence. structure.profile {profile, rule, sample_fps, and the rule's own params}: the structure profile and the rule that chose it (forced, forced_unknown {requested}, path_pattern, source_folder {folder}, disabled, no_profiles, all_manual, default, default_unusable, measured {signal}); profile is null when none applies. structure.declared_sparser {profile, sample_fps, measured_profile, measured_sample_fps}: a declared profile samples less densely than the footage measures for. output.present {output}: the output is already there, so the file is skipped. source.not_video, source.unreadable {exception_type}: skipped. source.transcoded: decoded through a transcoded copy.
